dispatch_requirement: The run action uses the existing authenticated stopped/idle exclusive cix-cxx-hygiene.slice helper, with a 1200-second worker RuntimeMaxSec and 1260-second client timeout. Its worker refuses ordinary or nested scheduling.
purpose: Narrow RocksDB public-header Sonar probe using a standard compilation-database carrier derived from the exact NDEBUG-qualified C++ argv. It preserves the original -I roots, categories, and order, changes only the owner TU input to the owned header, and makes no full-scan qualification claim. Blosc v2 success and the GIO parser limitation are retained separately.
